recognize_zh: 皮膚切片 MUM1 染色，真皮內密集腫瘤細胞幾乎全部呈強烈細胞核棕色陽性，表皮角質細胞為陰性；MUM1 瀰漫陽性是腿型原發皮膚瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤與濾泡中心淋巴瘤區分的重點。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate with strong diffuse nuclear MUM1/IRF4 positivity in nearly all tumor cells
Infiltrate extends up to the dermal-epidermal junction with minimal sparing
Overlying epidermis and hair follicle epithelium negative (internal negative control)
Negative vascular and stromal spaces between sheets of positive cells
Nuclear staining in relatively large nuclei
describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunostain on a skin biopsy shows strong diffuse nuclear positivity in nearly all cells of a dense dermal infiltrate extending up to the dermal-epidermal junction. The epidermis and adnexal epithelium are negative. Diffuse MUM1 expression in a large B-cell infiltrate supports a non-germinal center (activated B-cell) phenotype. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, diffuse pattern
ddx.vs: PCFCL is usually MUM1 negative, BCL2 negative or weak, and BCL6 positive with a germinal center phenotype.
Morphology and phenotype overlap, so staging studies are required to exclude systemic disease before assigning a primary cutaneous diagnosis.
Both are MUM1 positive but are CD20 negative and CD138 positive with plasmacytic morphology.
